name: Sortilegio
source:
Nali, my only friend, asks me to help him face those who wish him harm ţ and maybe, together, we’ll find what true friendship means.

[From [url=https://zaedia.itch.io/sortilegio]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
纳利，我唯一的朋友，请我帮助他面对那些希望他伤害的人……也许，我们一起，会发现真正的友谊意味着什么。

[来自[url=https://zaedia.itch.io/sortilegio]Itch.io[/url]]
